Tab.Label: Travel
Tab.noGm: A GM must be connected to change the travel.
Tab.tierHint: Comfort tier of the camp (house rule). It sets the DC of the end-of-stage fatigue save.
Tab.houseRule: House rule of the module: Constitution save at the end of each stage, at the DC of the comfort tier.
Tab.autonomyHint: Days of food and of water for the whole group, then the autonomy in full days.
Tab.noMembers: No member: add creatures to the group.
Tab.stageDays: {days} days on average ({preview} at the current pace)
Tab.stageNeeds: per member and per day: {food} ration(s), {water} water ration(s)

enabled.name: Enable Group Travel
enabled.hint: Adds the Travel tab to dnd5e group sheets.

rules.name: Travel rules
rules.label: Configure rules
rules.hint: Comfort values, default comfort tiers, actions, pace, water, item recognition and official rules.

Errors.wrongSystem: Group Travel requires the dnd5e system.

tiers.empty: Define at least one comfort tier.
tiers.min: A tier minimum is not a number.
tiers.duplicate: Two tiers have the same minimum.
tiers.floor: One tier must have no minimum (the lowest tier).
tiers.dc: Every tier needs a numeric DC.
tiers.name: Every tier needs a name.

action.label: Every action needs a name.
action.dc: Every action needs a numeric DC.
action.check: Choose the check of every action (a skill check needs a skill key).
action.formula: Food and water actions need a formula (for example 1d4).
action.value: A comfort action needs a numeric value.
action.duplicate: Two actions have the same identifier.

Errors.gmOnly: Only a GM can do this.
Errors.stageRunning: A stage is already in progress.
Errors.stageLocked: The stage in progress can be neither removed nor changed until it is closed.
Errors.wrongPhase: This is not possible at this point of the stage.
Errors.notMember: This actor is not a member of the stage.
Errors.actionDone: This member has already acted during this stage.
Errors.saveOrder: This save is not the next one of the member.
Errors.rollMissing: The roll message cannot be found.
Errors.rollAuthor: The roll message was not sent by you.
Errors.rollMismatch: The roll does not match the expected roll.
Errors.rollUsed: This roll message has already been used.

Errors.notActiveGm: This request must be sent to the active GM.
Errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

Errors.badTarget: The repair target must be a camp item held by a member of the stage or by the group.

travel.name: Give the travel a name.
travel.stage: Every stage needs a name and a duration of at least one day.

effects.notList: The effects of this table result are not a list and were ignored.
effects.type: An effect of unknown type was ignored.
effects.amount: A food or water loss without a valid amount was ignored.
effects.damage: An item damage effect with invalid settings was ignored.
effects.value: A comfort effect without a numeric value was ignored.

Warnings.noTable: The event table of this travel cannot be found: no event is drawn.

comfort.hint: House rule. Comfort = sum over shelter and bedding items of rarity value × condition factor × quantity, plus stage modifiers, minus the shortage penalty.
comfort.rarity: Value by rarity (an item without rarity counts as common)
comfort.shortage: Penalty when the stage is short of

tiers.hint: Copied into each new travel, where they can be edited. A tier applies from its minimum score; the lowest tier has no minimum.
tiers.name: Name

actions.hint: One action per character and per stage. A tool check without a tool key becomes a check of the given ability.
actions.label: Name

pace.hint: Fast: shorter stage, higher DC. Slow: longer stage, lower DC. The duration is rounded up to the next day.

water.hint: One water ration covers a member for one day. A full waterskin holds 4 pints.

fatigue.enabled: Constitution save at the end of each stage
fatigue.shortage: DC increase when short of food or water
fatigue.hint: A member who did not get a full day of food or water during the stage gets this increase once on the stage's fatigue save.

recognition.hint: Items are recognised by their dnd5e identifier first, then by name (case and accents ignored). Separate values with semicolons.

official.forcedMarchHint: Official rule: one Constitution save per hour of travel beyond 8 hours in a day, DC 10 + extra hours; a failure gives one level of exhaustion.
official.privationHint: Off by default. Applies the food and water rules of the dnd5e rules version (2014 or 2024) day by day, and sets and removes the Malnutrition and Dehydration states.

GM.undoConfirm: Restore rations, water, gear condition, exhaustion, privation states and the travel to their state before the last stage?

Card.shortage: The stage was short of food or water: comfort penalty.
Card.houseRule: Fatigue save at the comfort tier DC: house rule of the module.
Card.exhaustionDisabled: Exhaustion is disabled in this world: failures are not applied.

Config.title: Configure the travel
Config.name: Travel name
Config.running: A stage is in progress: changes apply from the closure on.
Config.stagesHint: Duration: average days at normal pace. Stage DC replaces the tier DC when set. Hours: walking hours per day (empty = the group sheet value, 8 by default).

stage.name: Name
stage.dcHint: Optional: replaces the DC of the comfort tier.
stage.foodHint: Rations per member and per day
stage.waterHint: Water rations per member and per day
stage.hoursHint: Walking hours per day: beyond 8, forced march

Config.tableHint: Drag a roll table here, paste its UUID, or create the example table.
Config.compendiumTable: compendium table: import it into the world to edit its effects
Config.effectsLocked: Effects can only be edited on a world table.
Config.effectsHint: Effects applied by each result. A successful watch halves them all (rounded down). Amounts: rations, water rations, items.
Config.deleteConfirm: Delete this travel and its history? Items and actors are not changed.
